# aHPy Code of Conduct

## Scope

This policy applies to the aHPy repository, issue tracker, pull requests, and
other project spaces controlled by the aHPy maintainers. It does not claim
authority over the upstream Cython or HPy projects.

## Expected behavior

Participants must be respectful, patient, technically honest, and welcoming.
Critique ideas and evidence rather than people. Give reproducible context,
acknowledge uncertainty, respect privacy, and accept a maintainer's decision to
move or end an unproductive discussion.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, threats, discrimination, sexualized attention, personal attacks,
doxing, deliberate intimidation, sustained disruption, and publication of
another person's private communications or identifying information without
permission are not acceptable.

## Reporting

Do not publish sensitive details in an issue. For conduct that also violates
GitHub policy, use [GitHub's private abuse report](https://support.github.com/contact/report-abuse).
For project-specific concerns, contact the repository owner through the
[maintainer's GitHub profile](https://github.com/mburakmmm). If no private
contact method is visible, open a minimal issue requesting private contact and
omit all sensitive details.

Security vulnerabilities follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md), not the conduct
process.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may edit or remove content, close or lock discussions, reject
contributions, or temporarily or permanently restrict participation. Decisions
will consider severity, context, recurrence, safety, and the need for a
productive technical community. Reports will be handled as privately as the
available channel permits; confidentiality cannot be promised for information
already posted publicly or where disclosure is legally required.
